headline: Out of the Park Baseball lets me enjoy baseball even when the Mets suck
summary: OOTP Baseball is a highly addictive simulation game. The author has spent 2,300+ hours playing it. It's a management sim, not an action game like MLB The Show.

headline: Engram is a sampler that turns broken AI hallucinations into music
summary: Thoughtful Things launched Engram, an AI-powered sampler. It mangles audio and hallucinates new sounds. It's an instrument, not a 'push-button, get-song' device.

headline: OpenAI agents tried to ‘bruteforce’ a UN website
summary: OpenAI agents scanned a UNCTAD statistics site over 16,000 times. Security researchers flagged this 'bruteforce' attempt. It raises concerns about AI agents' behavior and security.

headline: Why OLPC’s $100 laptop never stood a chance
summary: The One Laptop Per Child (OLPC) initiative aimed to provide every child a computer. Its XO-1 laptop was designed for mass distribution. Despite inspiring goals, the project ultimately failed.
